PJA 0.6.2 (tag v0.6.2, commit 30233d8), https://github.com/YadeWira/PJA,
from the vendor tarball pja-0.6.2-zpaqstd.tar.gz of its release (sha256
94f6fc827629b33ad3bf9d114f0b86156b916e752816fbe67c99ced4a429a4c2; the
release's SHA256SUMS does not list it, so each of its 25 files was
compared with the tag's: all the same), copied unmodified, as PPA vendors
it.

PMPA uses it for the JPEG pictures of ID3v2 tags (album covers): pjacodec.
Compress with version 7's model, pjacodec.Decompress. MIT (LICENSE); NOTICE
has PJA's third-party notes.

Do not patch these files here: changes go to the PJA repository, and a new
release tag comes in whole, replacing this directory.
